actions.name: 前臂支撑的负重腕掌屈
actions.phase: 坐位掌心向上的轻负荷腕掌屈
actions.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a single realistic rehabilitation exercise photo, vertical 1122×1402 pixel composition.
Input images 1, 2, and 3 are STRICT identity, wardrobe, photographic style, lighting and colour references: they show the SAME woman. Preserve her exact East Asian face, mature adult age, skin tone, natural normal adult head/body and limb proportions, black low ponytail, fitted white short-sleeved crewneck T-shirt and charcoal-grey long sports trousers. Match exactly the softly mottled pale cool grey-blue studio photographic background; continue it as a seamless matte floor in the same colour when the floor is visible. Soft diffuse studio light, realistic fine skin, hair and clothing texture. Same calm gentle expression, complete face visible, natural adult proportions.
Only one woman, one moment of one exercise, one standalone photograph. Anatomically accurate joints and five-fingered hands. No collage, inset, montage, arrows, diagram, angle marks, typography, number, logo, watermark, cartoon, extra people, coloured setting or unnecessary props. No clinical labels. Plain white logo-free sports shoes if feet are shown. Equipment is restrained neutral grey and physically stable.
Equipment and setup: a neutral matte grey rectangular stable table, simple neutral grey chair with backrest, and a small thin light-grey support pad under the exercising forearm at the table edge. The woman sits upright naturally, hips and knees comfortable, torso vertical, shoulder relaxed, upper arm near her side. Non-exercising hand rests relaxed on her own thigh. Show the full head and face, seated torso and enough lower body to make seated posture unambiguous; frame the wrist clearly without sacrificing natural body proportions.
Primary request: supported weighted wrist FLEXION, T-AXU-036. Her near-side forearm lies horizontally and remains firmly supported along the pad on the table, elbow bent near 90°. The entire forearm is SUPINATED with inner/volar forearm and palm facing UP. The wrist protrudes just beyond the table edge. She holds one small light compact grey dumbbell securely in the centre of her palm, not at fingertips. Curl the hand gently UP toward the palm/inner forearm by wrist flexion about 20–35°, while the elbow and forearm stay still and touching the pad. The knuckles and palm form a clearly flexed angle at the wrist, the inner forearm/palm side remains visible and facing upward, not downward. No forearm lifting, no elbow curl, no shoulder lifting, no leaning body. This MUST be palm-UP wrist flexion rather than palm-DOWN wrist extension. Camera from an oblique front-side angle where the wrist side profile AND supinated inner forearm are clearly readable, hand and compact dumbbell unobscured. Maintain a slight space around the complete head, and a useful visible wrist size. Small movement, normal anatomy.
actions.path: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/train/177_T-AXU-036_前臂支撑的负重腕掌屈.png
actions.final_path: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/train/177_T-AXU-036_前臂支撑的负重腕掌屈.png

corrections.prompt:
Targeted rehabilitation pose correction. Image 1 is edit target, images 2–4 are ORIGINAL strict identity, wardrobe, grey-blue background/soft lighting references. Preserve woman's exact face, black low ponytail, white shirt, charcoal trousers, full seated pose, chair, white shoes, realistic texture, natural anatomy and adult proportions. Keep image portrait 1122×1402, complete head/body visible. Change ONLY the compact table geometry, soft pad, exercising forearm and wrist alignment to correct SUPPORTED PALM-UP WRIST FLEXION.
Make the grey table NARROW in the elbow-to-hand direction, such that the far/right END of the table top stops immediately before her wrist; there must be EMPTY AIR and grey-blue floor/background under the hand and dumbbell beyond that end, not any tabletop. Table remains physically stable with four supporting legs. Place a thin long light-grey pad along the entire horizontal forearm, continuously supporting from elbow all the way to just BEFORE the wrist at the end of table. Entire forearm lies flat on this pad and its underside visibly CONTACTS it throughout. Forearm absolutely cannot hover or slope upward. Elbow 90°, upper arm relaxed near body. Wrist extends beyond table/pad end. Palm and inner forearm face UP (supinated). Secure the small grey dumbbell in the palm, not fingertips. Flex ONLY the wrist UP toward inner forearm by a visible gentle 25–30°, hand axis slightly rises beyond the horizontal supported forearm. This is palm-up wrist flexion; not palm-down extension, not elbow lifting. Show this small bent wrist in side profile, clear pad support and hand beyond edge. Other arm hand remains on thigh; torso upright. No text, arrows, inset, diagrams or other objects.
corrections.reason: 修正前臂支撑和桌边外自由手腕几何，保持动作方向

actions.visual_check: 人工逐图检查：首图前臂支撑不足、手位在桌面上方；一次定向修正后灰窄桌与连续浅灰软垫支撑肘至腕前，手与小哑铃悬于桌边外，内侧前臂朝上，腕小幅向掌侧屈曲。完整参考人物、正常成人比例、灰蓝背景与柔光一致；无多阶段拼图。图片只展示姿势，不推定负荷或疗效。

Primary request: gentle supported palm weight shift at a HIGH fixed table, T-AXU-039, initial easy STANDING version only. A stable neutral matte grey rectangular table is at WAIST height. Feet remain near table; do not step far backward. This is a gentle high-table palm-loading posture, NOT push-up, no deep elbow bend, no lying on table, no kneeling, no yoga or four-point quadruped pose. Side or oblique-side camera shows complete full body from head to both shoes with margin, normal proportions, entire head and reference face visible, both palm and wrist contacts clear. Only one table and one standing woman, no chair needed.
